admission.justification: A surviving imported product owner can make later modules depend on file scheduling; module-boundary reset/cleanup prevents that cross-module leak without restoring removed ambient state.

applicability: Module boundaries in pytest processes loading the repository bootstrap plugin.
conditions: The process mutable-state scanner resets only already-imported product modules.
The module fixture explicitly imports the lightweight kernel.worktree_service_binding reset owner and clears its bound services and pending supplier before and after each module.
exclusions: No reset between ordered cases of one test file.
No eager import merely to reset a collection-scanner owner; the dedicated kernel worktree-services holder is the explicit module-boundary exception.
statement: Each test module resets already-imported product collection owners and the dedicated kernel worktree-services holder before and after execution; removed ambient lifecycle and heartbeat owners are not reset or joined.
